method: Two-geometry inversion per pixel: track 34 ascending + track 114 descending cumulative LOS (track 114 interpolated in time to track 34 dates, both re-zeroed at the first common date); d_k = E*e_k + U*u_k with LOS unit vectors from the GUNW metadata cube; north motion neglected.
colormap: RdBu for both: up map red = sinking, blue = rising; east map red = moving west, blue = moving east
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
notes: ~1 km block medians (>= 50 % valid, within-block std <= 3 cm) for statistics. The single most negative block lies in the speckled south-east foothill/orchard edge (lower confidence); the Alpaugh bowl is the clearest broad feature. Each track carries ~2-3 cm of atmospheric noise per pair; east-west values are noisier than up because the two LOS vectors differ mainly in their east component.
